speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease (CJD). The progression from psychiatric symptoms (depression, confusion) to rapid cognitive decline with myoclonus (involuntary movements) and dysphagia, in the absence of metabolic or toxic causes, is highly suggestive of CJD. The MRI of the brain should show cortical ribboning or basal ganglia hyperintensity to confirm this.
